2. Kukkurajātaka Hounds: a past life story

“Ye kukkurā rājakulamhi vaddhā, The dogs raised in the royal family, Koleyyakā vaṇṇabalūpapannā; pedigreed, handsome and strong, Teme na vajjhā mayamasma vajjhā, are not slaughtered, we are slaughtered— Nāyaṁ saghaccā dubbalaghātikāyan”ti. this is not the mutts deserving death, this is the killing of the weak.

Kukkurajātakaṁ dutiyaṁ.
